product_one_liner.value: ComplyAdvantage provides AI-driven financial-crime risk intelligence, customer screening, and transaction and payment monitoring for financial institutions, fintechs, and other businesses managing AML and compliance risk.

employee_band.notes: The company profile explicitly lists the 201–500 size band; its separate associated-person estimate is 510, so the headcount signals are inconsistent.

eng_blog.notes: Two engineering-authored posts explain the distributed-SQL platform and the Payment Screening team’s Elasticsearch implementation.

public_docs.notes: Public Mesh documentation includes onboarding, screening, authentication, monitoring, and API integration guidance.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current official board lists 16 openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. Third-party Data Scientist reposts are not present on that board.

model_provider.notes: The company explicitly says it runs Gemini in production for adverse-media article classification; no model version is specified.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 are explicit certification claims; GDPR is described as alignment, not a separate certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest identifiable financing round: debt dated 2025-05-19. A later filing records small ordinary-share cash allotments over 2025-02-27 to 2025-12-19; it does not identify a separate new funding round or disclose a USD round amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The debt round is dated 2025-05-19, inside 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09; Companies House records related secured-debt activity in May 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current official board includes Account Executive, Commercial; Account Executive; Business Development Representative; and Strategic Account Executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Payment Screening on Mesh launched on 2026-05-19, inside the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Rhiannon Prothero announced joining as Global Vice President, Marketing on 2026-06-05, inside the requested twelve-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Founding GTM Engineer posting explicitly names these systems and calls Salesforce the system of record.
